build_hard_negative_pool: build a hard negative sample pool by querying nearest neighbors from image features using BallTree
create_get_neighbors: create a function that queries k-nearest neighbors from a BallTree index for each image feature
run_load_image_features: run loading image features from an HDF5 file and compute per-image pooled features
run_build_ball_tree: run building a BallTree index over pooled image features for nearest neighbor search
run_save_hard_pool_cache: run saving the hard negative pool and image list to a pickle cache file
